service.description: ZE-ROLE-012: edit a user's username + full name. Same validation as create; username uniqueness enforced. Moqui auto-audits UserAccount.username AND userFullName to EntityAuditLog on update, recording acting user (changedByUserId), target user (pkPrimaryValue), timestamp (changedDate) and old/new value per changed field — so every user edit is auditable.

return.message: Username must contain letters, not only numbers or symbols.
Username must be at least 3 characters.
Please enter a valid full name — it must contain letters, not only numbers or symbols.

service.description: ZE-ROLE-010: permanently delete a user so the username can be reused. Succeeds ONLY for a history-less user — the DB enforces FKs on party (240) and user_account (24), so a user with any activity (orders, bills, contacts, logins, ...) makes the delete fail and the whole thing roll back; we catch that and tell the admin to disable instead (which preserves records). The caller and any administrator are refused up front so nobody can delete themselves or the last admin.

return.message: You can't delete your own account.
This user is an administrator. Remove the administrator role first, or disable the account instead of deleting it.
